duration.text: The TCM Pediatrics at Hunan University of Chinese Medicine is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Filling in Hunan University of TCM Application Form for admission application.doc 6. Certification of no crime 7. 20 pictures of 2-inch size, 10 pictures of 1-inch size （on a white background）

requirements.text: 1. Bachelor or equivalent 2. Two associate professors’ recommendation letters 3. All the foreign students need to attend the HSK TEST 4. The foreign students who pursue any degree of bachelor, master or doctor have to attend to the Entrance Exam of the university
